events.title: Miami Marketta Street Food Night
events.description: A relaxed midweek street food market with global food vendors, a gin parlour, and free live music on the Cargo Stage. Perfect for casual mingling and enjoying a lively laneway atmosphere.

events.title: The Magik Markets
events.description: An enchanting evening market featuring tarot and psychic readings, witchy stalls, crystals, and handcrafted treasures. Explore a mystical atmosphere, seek guidance, or find unique artisanal items.

events.title: Mamma Mia Night | Sip & Paint
events.description: A creative hands-on workshop to paint a Mediterranean-inspired artwork while enjoying ABBA music and a drink. All materials and a canvas are included; no prior experience is needed, encouraging creative expression in a social setting.

events.title: Drag Bingo GC
events.description: A lively, inclusive Drag Bingo event hosted by Dixie Wrecked & Ivyy Monroe, featuring epic drag performances, a DJ, themed cocktails, and street food. Expect a loud, proud, and unforgettable night.

events.title: "Call Me Maybe" Presents...
events.description: A live music event presented by "Call Me Maybe" at Miami Marketta. Specific lineup and ticket details are available on the Oztix event page.

events.title: Superficial Presents...
events.description: A live music event presented by "Superficial" at Miami Marketta. Artist lineup and ticket details can be found on the Oztix event page.

events.title: MBG
events.description: MBG performs live at Miami Marketta, the Gold Coast's first creative precinct known for bringing together creativity, food, and live music. Check Oztix for ticket details.

events.title: The Screaming Jets & Large Mirage
events.description: A big night of Australian rock featuring The Screaming Jets, Large Mirage, Jon Stevens, Boom Crash Opera, Choirboys, and Dave Gleeson at the iconic Miami Marketta laneway venue.

events.title: Musical Bingo
events.description: A weekly musical bingo night blending music trivia with traditional bingo, offering a fun and interactive community social event at the Coolangatta Hotel.

events.title: Drag Bingo
events.description: A lively and inclusive weekly Drag Bingo night hosted by queens at the Coolangatta Hotel, offering a fierce and fun social experience.

events.title: Monday Trivia Night
events.description: A weekly community trivia night at the Coolangatta Hotel where teams can test their knowledge and compete for prizes in a social setting.

events.title: Gold Coast Pride Fair Day
events.description: A free, welcoming community celebration at HOTA featuring live entertainment, food trucks, stalls, family activities, drag performances, and a pet parade. A vibrant event for the Gold Coast's LGBTQIA+ community and allies.

events.title: "This Moment" Exhibition – White Rabbit Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: A major free exhibition at HOTA Gallery featuring 35 artworks from 25 leading contemporary Chinese artists, exploring themes of identity, history, and transformation through various mediums including installation, video, and painting.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart (Children's Gallery)
events.description: An immersive and interactive children's exhibition by First Nations artist Lisa Sorbie Martin, bringing Torres Strait childhood memories to life through ocean-inspired art, patterns, and creative play. Designed to engage children and families.

events.title: Gold Coast TechSpace - Wednesday Hack Night
events.description: A weekly open hack night at Gold Coast TechSpace, a maker/hacker and education centre, welcoming visitors to work on projects, collaborate, and explore various tech and creative interests like electronics, coding, and IoT.

events.title: Mudgeeraba Show
events.description: One of the Gold Coast's longest-running community events, celebrating rural traditions, local agriculture, and family entertainment with animals, rides, competitions, food, and various performances.

events.title: Josh Pyke Solo Tour (SoundLounge)
events.datetime: Check SoundLounge website for June dates
events.description: Double J presents Josh Pyke on his "Feeding the Wolves and Other Stories" solo tour, celebrating a 20th-anniversary milestone at the Gold Coast's premier live music venue, SoundLounge.
